2608.25738.title: MeMark: Membrane-Space Watermarking for Spiking Neural Networks
2608.25738.paper_summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are increasingly distributed as pretrained checkpoints and reused as backbones for new tasks. However, current SNN watermarks are mainly verified against the model output. Thus, a user who replaces the output head can keep most of the original network while removing the evidence used for verification. We present MeMark, a watermark designed for the checkpoint-reuse setting. Instead of storing the watermark in the output head, MeMark embeds a multi-bit identifier in the internal membrane state of selected Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons. A secret input drives each selected neuron to the chosen side of its own firing threshold, and the same threshold is later used to recover the secret bit, so the verifier does not need a learned decoder. We evaluate MeMark across recurrent, convolutional, residual, and transformer SNNs. On a 215.4M-parameter SpikeGPT checkpoint, all 20 independent 64-bit keys pass the fixed 51/64 verification rule, while none of the $30\,000$ fresh random keys pass when tested against all 20 protected checkpoints and the clean model. All 20 genuine keys also remain above the threshold after fine-tuning, 90\% pruning, int8 quantization, and output-head replacement. Under our stated threat model, adaptive attacks can weaken the watermark but do not remove the ownership evidence in the settings we test. Additionally, we study false ownership claims, key-aware and key-agnostic removal, partial key disclosure, rollback, and extraction into a student. The results show that MeMark can provide evidence of checkpoint derivatives, while being resistant to the adversary's attacks and complete head replacement.
2608.25738.paper_summary_zh: 尖峰神經網絡（SNNs）越來越多地以預訓練檢查點的形式分發，並作為新任務的骨幹重用。<lb/>然而，當前的 SNN 水印主要是針對模型輸出進行驗證。<lb/>因此，替換輸出頭的用戶可以保留大部分原始網絡，同時移除用於驗證的證據。<lb/>我們提出了 MeMark，一種為檢查點重用設計的水印。<lb/>MeMark 不是將水印存儲在輸出頭中，而是將多位標識符嵌入選定的漏積分火（LIF）神經元的內部膜狀態中。<lb/>一個秘密輸入驅動每個選定的神經元達到其自身的發火閾值的選定側，並且同一閾值稍後用於恢復秘密位，因此驗證者不需要學習解碼器。<lb/>我們在遞歸、卷積、殘差和Transformer SNN 上評估了 MeMark。<lb/>在一個 215.4M 參數的 SpikeGPT 檢查點上，所有 20 個獨立的 64 位密鑰都通過了固定的 51/64 驗證規則，而當測試所有 20 個受保護的檢查點和乾淨模型時，$30\,000$ 個新隨機密鑰均未通過。<lb/>所有 20 個真實密鑰在微調、90\% 剪枝、int8 量化和輸出頭替換後仍然高於閾值。<lb/>根據我們所述的威脅模型，自適應攻擊可以削弱水印，但在我們測試的設置中不會移除所有權證據。<lb/>此外，我們研究了虛假所有權聲明、密鑰感知和無密鑰移除、部分密鑰披露、回滾和提取到學生中。<lb/>結果顯示，MeMark 可以提供檢查點衍生物的證據，同時對對手的攻擊和完全頭部替換具有抵抗力。
